Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 2011
ACT I OF 2011
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary,
22nd January, 2011]
No.PAP-Legis-2(58)/2010/319, dated 22-1-2011.---The Provincial Motor
vehicles (amendment) Bill 2010,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 12 January,
2011, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 21 January, 2011, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (XIX of 1965), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is enacted as follows:---
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be cited as the Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment in section 50 of Ordinance XIX of 1965

ACT I OF 2011
ACT I OF 2011
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary,
22nd January, 2011]
No.PAP-Legis-2(58)/2010/319, dated 22-1-2011.---The Provincial Motor
vehicles (amendment) Bill 2010,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 12 January,
2011, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 21 January, 2011, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (XIX of 1965), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is enacted as follows:---
2. Amendment in section 50 of Ordinance XIX
of 1965.---In
the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance 1965 (XIX of 1965), hereinafter
referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 50, for subsection (1), the
following shall be substituted:--
"(1) A Regional Transport Authority
or the Provincial Transport Authority shall insert a condition in every stage
carriage permit that in case of death of or injury to a passenger in the stage
carriage arising out of the use of the stage carriage, the permit holder shall
pay, as compensation to the passenger or the legal representatives of the passenger,
the amount specified in the Thirteenth Schedule."

Amendment in section 53 of Ordinance XIX of 1965

Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary,
22nd January, 2011]
No.PAP-Legis-2(58)/2010/319, dated 22-1-2011.---The Provincial Motor
vehicles (amendment) Bill 2010,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 12 January,
2011, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 21 January, 2011, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (XIX of 1965), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is enacted as follows:---
3. Amendment in section 53 of Ordinance XIX
of 1965.---In
the said Ordinance, in section 53, for
the subsection (2), the following shall be substituted:--
"(2) The Regional Transport
Authority or the Provincial Transport Authority shall insert a condition in
every contract carriage permit, other than a permit in respect of a contract
carriage constructed, adapted or used for carrying not more than six passengers
including the driver, that in case of death of or injury to a passenger in the
contract carriage arising out of the use of the contract carriage, the permit
holder shall pay, as compensation to the passenger or the legal representatives
of the passenger, the amount specified in the Thirteenth Schedule."

Amendment in section 67 of Ordinance XIX of 1965

No.PAP-Legis-2(58)/2010/319, dated 22-1-2011.---The Provincial Motor
vehicles (amendment) Bill 2010,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 12 January,
2011, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 21 January, 2011, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (XIX of 1965), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is enacted as follows:---
4. Amendment in section 67 of Ordinance XIX
of 1965.---In
the said Ordinance, in section 67, for subsection (1), the following shall be substituted:--
"(1) In the case of death of or
injury to a passenger in a stage carriage or a contract carriage, other than a
contract carriage constructed, adapted or used to carry not more than six
passengers including the driver, arising out of the use of such carriage, the
holder of the permit, or in the absence of the permit, the owner of the
carriage shall pay, as compensation to the passenger or the legal
representatives of the passenger, the amount specified in the Thirteenth
Schedule."
